 Advertisement Warm Wednesday; wet & chilly end to week in south central Pennsylvania
 Highs will reach the mid-60s again on Wednesday, then fall to the 40s by Friday.
 Advertisement Updated: 11:28 PM EST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Susko Meteorologist Ethan Huston Meteorologist Warm Wednesday; wet & chilly end to week in south central Pennsylvania
 Highs will reach the mid-60s again on Wednesday, then fall to the 40s by Friday.
 Updated: 11:28 PM EST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Susko Meteorologist Ethan Huston Meteorologist Tonight, winds diminish and temperatures will fall to the upper 30s to 40 degrees under clear skies.
 After a round of morning sunshine, clouds will increase Wednesday. Highs will remain warm, in the mid-60s. Winds will be light.
 Advertisement As low pressure approaches Thursday, scattered showers will develop in the morning and continue at times through evening. Highs will be cooler, in the mid-50s.
 As low pressure moves east Friday, showers will gradually end, and the breeze will increase, pulling cooler air into Pennsylvania. Highs will fall to the mid-40s.
 Breezy conditions continue Saturday, as low pressure departs. Highs will reach the upper 40s.
 Sunday will feature partly sunny skies, a brisk breeze, and highs near 50.
 Next week, dry weather continues, and highs will warm a few degrees each day, eventually reaching 60 degrees by the end of the week.
 Have a great night!
